Who's Behind PTx

Clinic-based sessions around Swindon
How I Work
Expert assessment first, then a plan built around movement. I use targeted stretches and strengthening, utilising strength and conditioning principles, with extensive practical experience of gym-based training, yoga and pilates, alongside hands-on treatment, clear education and practical advice, so you understand your problem and know how to manage it.
Evidence-led. Movement-first.
Pricing · Introductory Rates
PT1 — Initial Assessment
Start here.

A thorough initial assessment, hands-on treatment, and an honest answer: is this a one-off fix, or does it need more? 60 minutes.

£68
PT2 — Follow-Up Session
Keep the progress going.

A focused follow-up session, building on your assessment. Agreed with you at the end of your appointment, never pre-booked. 45 minutes.

£55
PT3 — Block of 4 Follow-Ups
Better value for the long run.

For people who need ongoing support through their rehab. A discounted block of four follow-ups, agreed together if and when it’s right for you.

£195
Everything starts with PT1. If you need more, we’ll talk it through at the end of your appointment — no pressure to rebook. Already paid for a PT2 session? That cost comes off a PT3 block if you upgrade afterwards.
How It Works

Clinic room sessions

A dedicated, private treatment room, by appointment — evenings and weekends.

Home or gym visits may be possible at an extra cost — get in touch to discuss.

Availability
Evening & weekend appointments — when everywhere else is closed.

Most physio clinics run 9–5, Monday to Friday. PTx is built around your week instead.

I’m staying on as an NHS First Contact Practitioner, which keeps my skills sharp and current — and means you can be seen without taking time off work.

Thursday clinics also available.
